references.title: Semantic ranking in Azure AI Search
references.note: Reranker scores run 0 to 4 and the ranker reorders the top 50 candidates, so score thresholds must be coarse and re-tested.

references.title: Query a knowledge base using the retrieve action or MCP endpoint
references.note: Retrieve calls without a user identity header return unfiltered results from indexed sources, a fail-open retrieval risk (preview API).

glossary.def: Declining to answer, or answering that the evidence does not support a response, instead of guessing.
Splitting an answer into individual claims and testing each against the evidence, which catches one bad sentence in an otherwise grounded answer.
The setting (Off, Low, Medium, High) that decides how severe a harm-category detection must be before a guardrail control flags it.
A streaming mode that sends tokens immediately and delivers filter annotations in separate messages, so violating text can appear briefly before the stop signal.
The share of requests that are truly harmful. At low base rates even an accurate guard produces mostly false alarms.
Running a guard and logging what it would do without acting, so you can measure false positives before enforcing.
Ordering checks from cheap and deterministic to expensive and model based, and invoking the costly ones only for high-risk or borderline cases.
Replacing sensitive values with tokens and keeping the mapping in a protected store so authorised code can restore them in the response.
Overwriting sensitive characters, for example with an asterisk, so the value cannot be recovered from the output.
The flow language used with YAML configuration in NeMo Guardrails to define allowed dialog paths and actions.
A check before generation that decides whether the retrieved evidence is sufficient to answer, and routes to abstention if not.

claims.text: Foundry guardrails support four intervention points: user input, tool call (preview, agents only), tool response (preview, agents only) and output; agents support only annotate and block.
NeMo Guardrails names five rail types: input, retrieval, dialog, execution and output; retrieval rails filter chunks and execution rails check tool calls.
Retrieve calls without a user identity header return unfiltered results from indexed sources (fail open).
The asynchronous filter streams token by token and guarantees the stop signal only within about a 1,000 character window; the default mode buffers and filters each chunk.
Azure groundedness detection is preview, English only, supports domains Medical and Generic and tasks Summarization and QnA.
Groundedness detection limits: grounding sources 55,000 characters, text plus query 7,500 characters, query at least 3 words; applies to models, not agents, in Foundry guardrails.
NeMo `self check facts` uses `$relevant_chunks`, returns a 0.0 to 1.0 score and fails closed (score 0.0) when a reasoning model spends its `max_tokens` before answering.
Anthropic guidance: for documents over 20k tokens ask for word-for-word quotes first and give explicit permission to say I don't know.
SummaC applies sentence-level NLI and aggregates; TRUE is a meta-evaluation of factual consistency metrics; AlignScore is a unified alignment function.

Anthropic Citations: enabled on document or search_result blocks, types char_location, page_location and content_block_location, cited_text not counted as output tokens, HTTP 400 when combined with structured outputs.
Azure semantic reranker scores run 0 to 4, only the top 50 candidates are reranked, and scores drift across model updates.
Foundry guardrails severity levels are safe (annotated, never filtered), low, medium and high; thresholds are Off, Low, Medium and High, and Off is only for approved customers.
Standalone Content Safety text severity is 0 to 7 or trimmed 0, 2, 4, 6 with adjacent pairs merged; the image model returns 0, 2, 4, 6 only.

The default guardrail Microsoft.DefaultV2 sets hate, violence, sexual and self-harm to Medium on prompts and completions and applies to all Foundry Models sold by Azure except audio transcription models.
Content Safety limits: analyze text 10K characters, image 4 MB and 50x50 to 7200x7200 pixels, multimodal text 1K characters.

Harm category models were trained and tested on English, German, Japanese, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese and Chinese; Prompt Shields, protected material and groundedness were tested on English only.
Prompt Shields has two shields: user prompt attacks and document attacks; in Foundry, document attacks are scanned at user input and tool response.
The standalone Prompt Shields API takes one userPrompt and up to five documents and returns attackDetected; Prompt Shields has been GA since August 2024.
Spotlighting (Azure) base64 encodes documents, is off by default, works on the Chat Completions API for models only (not agents), is preview and raises token count.
The Spotlighting paper reports attack success dropping from above 50 percent to below 2 percent on GPT-family models with minimal task impact.

Protected material: text and code filters scan completions, English only, minimum 110 characters; thresholds quoted are 40 characters for recipes, 200 for news and 11 words for lyrics; code index is current only through 2023-04-06.
Protected material code filter status is UNVERIFIED: a September 2024 notice labelled it preview while the Foundry risk table lists it without a preview label.

Custom categories (standard) page says it retires 2026-09-01 and points to Foundry custom text classification; rapid is preview; task adherence entered public preview in November 2025 with a 100K character input.
An agent's guardrail fully overrides its model's guardrail; with none assigned it inherits the model's; guardrails apply only to agents built in Foundry Agent Service.
Spotlighting and groundedness controls are applicable to models but not agents; PII, task adherence, protected material and indirect attacks apply to both.
The Foundry PII filter scans model output only, is preview, follows Azure Language categories and can annotate or annotate and block the whole output.
Creating Foundry guardrails needs the Foundry Account Owner role, renamed from Azure AI Account Owner.
NeMo Guardrails is open-source Python with a Kubernetes microservice option, uses YAML and Colang, and its docs list v0.22.0 to v0.24.1 plus a Latest build.
Guardrails Hub showed 65 validators on 2026-10-13, and its detect PII validator uses Microsoft Presidio.

Llama Guard 4 is 12B parameters, natively multimodal, runs on one GPU, is a drop-in for Llama Guard 3 8B and 11B and classifies text and image together, not image alone; Llama Guard 3 categories run S1 to S14 and category text can be rewritten.
Azure AI Language PII has text (sync), conversation (async) and document-based (async, .pdf, .docx, .txt) features; the AI Search PII skill takes at most 50,000 characters per input.
Presidio has an analyzer, anonymizer, image redactor and structured data module, can call Azure AI Language, warns it cannot guarantee finding all PII, and moved to presidio.dataprivacystack.org.
Guard call latency of tens to a few hundred milliseconds per classifier and one to several seconds for an LLM judge is an author ESTIMATE, not a vendor figure.
With base rate 1 percent, TPR 95 percent and FPR 2 percent, precision is about 32 percent (95 true blocks versus 198 false blocks per 10,000 requests).
